lines.cn: 弗兰克的第一份工作是什么？

lines.en: Yesterday afternoon Frank Hawkins was telling me about
lines.cn: 昨天下午，弗兰克·霍金斯跟我讲起了这件事。

lines.en: his experiences as a young man.

lines.cn: 弗兰克是……的负责人（或主管）。

lines.en: a very large business company, but as a boy he used to work in a small shop.
lines.cn: 这是一家规模非常大的企业，但小时候他曾在一家小商店里工作过。

lines.en: It was his job to repair bicycles
lines.cn: 他的工作就是修理自行车。

lines.en: and at that time he used to work fourteen hours a day.
lines.cn: 那时，他每天要工作十四个小时。

lines.en: He saved money for years and
in 1958 he bought a small workshop of his own.
lines.cn: 1958年，他买下了属于自己的一个小作坊。

lines.en: In his twenties Frank used to make spare parts for aeroplanes.
lines.cn: 二十多岁的时候，弗兰克经常为飞机制造零部件。

lines.en: At that time he had two helpers.
In a few years the small workshop had become a large factory
lines.cn: 几年后，那个小作坊已经发展成了一家大工厂。

lines.en: which employed seven hundred and twenty-eight people.
lines.cn: 该公司雇用了七百二十八名员工。

lines.en: Frank smiled when he remembered his hard early years and the long road to success.
lines.cn: 弗兰克想起自己早年艰难的岁月以及通往成功的漫长道路时，露出了微笑。

lines.en: He was still smiling when the door opened and his wife came in.
lines.cn: 门打开时，他仍在微笑，他的妻子走了进来。

lines.en: She wanted him to repair their grandson's bicycle!
lines.cn: 她希望他能修理他们孙子的自行车！
